info.title: CF Meet public API — developer-platform
info.description: Section 50 developer / enterprise control plane, served through the public API Gateway. Human console operations use the verified CF Meet session (verified by the Meeting Service through the session bridge); server automation uses scoped Platform Access credentials where noted. Organizations, projects and environments are Developer Platform metadata over canonical Platform Access tenants, applications and environments: Platform Access remains the only identity, credential and scope authority. Non-members get NOT_FOUND for another tenant's resources. Every response carries X-Request-Id. Section 53 central webhooks: the Developer Console manages an environment's webhook subscriptions, delivery and attempt history and replays under /v1/environments/{environmentId}/webhooks* and /webhook-deliveries/*. The machine-credential webhook API keeps Calling's public contract and paths (cfmeet.calling.http-api /v1/webhooks*); the API Gateway re-points it to the Developer Platform at the cut-over (cfmeet.developer-platform.internal-api documents the served routes).

get.summary: List the webhook subscriptions of an environment
get.description: Subscriptions of the environment with their origin and endpoint health. Roles: OWNER, ADMIN, DEVELOPER, ANALYST (Developer Console session only).

200.description: A page of subscriptions (never a secret).

post.summary: Create a webhook subscription in an environment
post.description: Server-generated signing secret, returned ONCE (an Idempotency-Key replay returns the subscription without it). Roles: OWNER, ADMIN, DEVELOPER (Developer Console session only); refused while the organization is restricted, suspended or closed.

201.description: The subscription and its signing secret.

get.summary: Get a webhook subscription of an environment
get.description: Another environment's subscription is 404. Roles: OWNER, ADMIN, DEVELOPER, ANALYST (Developer Console session only).

patch.summary: Update a webhook subscription of an environment
patch.description: expectedVersion is required (stale: 409 VERSION_CONFLICT). Re-enabling resets the endpoint health. Roles: OWNER, ADMIN, DEVELOPER (Developer Console session only); refused while the organization is restricted, suspended or closed.

delete.summary: Delete a webhook subscription of an environment
delete.description: Soft delete: open deliveries are CANCELLED; history is kept. Roles: OWNER, ADMIN, DEVELOPER (Developer Console session only); refused while the organization is restricted, suspended or closed.

parameters.name: expectedVersion
parameters.description: The subscription version the change is based on (stale: 409 VERSION_CONFLICT).

post.summary: Rotate the signing secret of a subscription
post.description: The new secret is returned ONCE. Roles: OWNER, ADMIN, DEVELOPER (Developer Console session only); refused while the organization is restricted, suspended or closed.

200.description: The subscription and its new signing secret.

get.description: Delivery history (FAILED dead letters, SHADOW records of shadow mode). Roles: OWNER, ADMIN, DEVELOPER, ANALYST (Developer Console session only).

get.summary: List the attempts of a delivery
get.description: Status class and bounded error class of every attempt (never a response body). Roles: OWNER, ADMIN, DEVELOPER, ANALYST (Developer Console session only).

post.description: A NEW delivery of the same event (same event id) to the same active subscription; dead letters included. Roles: OWNER, ADMIN, DEVELOPER (Developer Console session only); refused while the organization is restricted, suspended or closed.

platformCredential.description: A Platform Access API credential (server-side only; never in a browser).

userSession.description: The signed-in developer's CF Meet session (Developer Console). Never a machine credential.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Replays return the original response; reuse with a different request is IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED. One-time secrets are never replayed.

IdempotentReplayed.description: `true` when the response is the stored result of an earlier request with the same Idempotency-Key (no new effect).

platform-developer.common.v1.Error.description: Error envelope (Cache-Control: no-store). Messages never contain an identifier, credential, token or database text.

summary.description: Safe change summary: opaque ids, codes and display metadata only — never secrets, credentials, contacts or E2EE material.

platform-developer.control.v1.BillingAcc.description: Billing-account REFERENCE metadata. Never card, bank, charge or balance data.

platform-developer.control.v1.Commercial.description: An immutable commercial plan version. No price exists in Part VI.

origin.description: NATIVE, or migrated from Calling's legacy webhook store (id preserved).

signingSecret.description: Returned ONLY by create and rotate-secret; absent from an Idempotency-Key replay of a create (never stored).

url.description: Public https endpoint. Server-side validation additionally refuses every loopback / private / link-local / CGNAT / metadata address and re-checks the resolved address at connection time (DNS rebinding); redirects are never followed.

platform-developer.webhooks.v1.DeliveryS.description: FAILED is the dead letter (replayable). SHADOW: recorded while the platform ran in shadow mode before the cut-over; deliberately not sent.

disabledReason.description: CONSECUTIVE_FAILURES: disabled automatically; re-enabling resets the health.
